g.text: Synthetic 160 × 160-pixel scene, six Sentinel-2-like bands, with parcels at different growth stages, textured built-up areas, blur, illumination changes and noise. 400
labelled pixels per class from the western half train each model; all 12 800 pixels of the eastern half test it. CNN: one 5 × 5 × 64 convolution, ReLU, 1 × 1 output
